cell_line.evidence: 3T3-L1 preadipocytes were obtained from the American Type Culture Collection (CL-173) and cultured at subconfluency in high glucose DMEM containing stabilized glutamine and sodium pyruvate, supplemented with 10% FBS (Sigma-Aldrich, N4637) and 1% PS (Sigma-Aldrich, #P4333), at 37°C and 5% CO2.

HeLa WT and SKO cells (gifted by R. Yang) were maintained in high glucose (4.5 g/liter) with stabilized glutamine and with sodium pyruvate Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s medium (DMEM) (Dutscher) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (PS) (GibcoBRL).
